definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. stoði (wk.) a post; styðja a post.

quotations.old_english: Tó ðam ilcan wuda ðár ic ðás stuðansceaftas cearf

source_text: stuðan-sceaft, es; m. A prop, stay:--Ic gaderode stuþansceaftas, Shrn. 163, 5. Tó ðam ilcan wuda ðár ic ðás stuðansceaftas cearf, 14. [Cf. Icel. stoði (wk.) a post; styðja a post.] v. studu.
